name: no-siren-feature
description: Ablation of the auxiliary pointwise input SIREN(x_t, z), NOT of the conditioning itself: z is still concatenated into the input and still drives the AdaGN modulation, so the model stays fully Functa-conditioned. With mass IoU averaging 0.85 and collapsing on the tail, that extra per-point boundary feature may be actively misleading the vector field exactly where the decoded region is wrong.
